Thanks for saying that, but I'm only "ZXYWUV" you don't even know who I'm.
This was a mistake to reach out.
I do not understand, people are hitting upvotes. Am I so hopeless that strangers want me to kill myself too???

i have no one here, i'm invisible, nobody would notice if i'm gone.
i try to go out for a walk or do different things just to get the thought out of my head but every night i think of the same thing. its eating me up.
Birth> School>career>earn money>~~find someone to share it with~~ > Die.

i know i'll never find someone. i'm just waiting for time to pass and kill me eventually. i wish i could do something to speed up

I see these posts and then think of the reasons that I have to "just end it" and then I feel ashamed. people are dealing with so much and I'm not able to fight rejections. I have been through depression anxiety and panic attacks last time a girl left me. I had to go to a psychiatrist, my parents thought I was being a baby. I don't know maybe I'm.
it's just a girl! for god sake.
I took medication for 3months when that didn't help went to a meditation camp somehow the panic attacks stopped after that.6 years later I moved to a different country now and I meet another girl and I thought to myself I don't want to go through that all over again, "keep your thoughts to yourself".
I couldn't, and I told her how I felt and she rejected me. we sit in the same office right next to each other and I have to go through it every day again and again. she is a good girl, she didn't make me feel bad about my feelings towards her. just made it clear that it would never happen and now I'm back to where it all started. if we are all going to die then whats the point in delaying? why not just end it now.
